overview.startPoint: Find a collection of swords while raiding the 12-17 abandoned floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.

questReqs.text: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

notes: This guide is for 100% completion and to receive the unabridged tome.
It does not matter whether the player completes the Noble or Ruthless path, it purely affects the cutscene at the end of the saga.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.
